findings.text: The more consciously sculpted adult in you
findings.what: "Sculpted" does not fit an adult who answers the parent script; a word like "developed" or "conscious" is meant.
findings.fix: The more consciously developed adult in you

findings.text: is that sudden "waking up" to all the ways
findings.what: "is that sudden waking up" does not parse; the side-effect is the sudden waking up, so "that" should be "the".
findings.fix: is the sudden "waking up" to all the ways

findings.text: surrendering to the hypnotist while playing asleep
findings.what: "Playing asleep" is not an idiom and means nothing; likely "falling asleep" or "playing dead" was meant.
findings.fix: surrendering to the hypnotist while falling asleep

notes: Block 243 refers to a section called "When you're already trancey" while block 228 names it "Already trancey? Stabilize before dipping deeper."; I could not check the real heading, so it is not reported as a finding. Everything else read as Joel's voice or technique.
